rows.query: What choices does FFCS give students?
rows.actual_answer: FFCS offers students choices in the order of course selection, timings/time slots, and the number of courses per semester. Students can also prepare their own timetable and academic plan. The system provides a balanced curriculum with engineering, science, humanities, and management courses, and ample opportunities for inter-disciplinary courses. It also offers optional summer/intersession semesters, opportunities for undergraduate research experience, and value addition through double Major/Minor/Honours options. Additionally, there is a branch change option in B.Tech at the end of the first year for high performers.

rows.query: Can I borrow library books using another student’s ID card?
rows.actual_answer: No, you cannot borrow library books using another student's ID card. Books will be issued through ID card along with biometric authentication.

rows.query: What does the counselling division offer students?
rows.actual_answer: The Counselling Division offers professional therapeutic counselling to students at any level of study to help them flourish personally, academically, and professionally. They provide assistance for a wide range of issues and are available 24/7 on call and during working hours in their cabins. The division aims to help students overcome emotional difficulties and problems at an earlier stage.

rows.query: What is SASDAL and what support does it provide?
rows.actual_answer: SASDAL stands for Service and Support for Differently Abled Learners. It operates under the Office of Students’ Welfare and aims to assist differently-abled learners in continuing their education smoothly. Support provided includes ramp structures, lifts, accessible toilets, faculty awareness, extra time for examinations, scribe facilities, and counseling for stress.

rows.query: How do I apply for an academic transcript?
rows.actual_answer: To apply for an academic transcript, you need to have your Registration Number, VIT Alumni Email ID, and Date of Birth. If you don't know your Alumni Email ID, contact alumni@vit.ac.in or call +91 416 220 2095. Go to https://vtop.vit.ac.in (Chrome and Firefox only supported), click Alumni Login, and then log on using your credentials. Fill in the required details and make the necessary payments. If you wish to receive a soft copy (in PDF format) of the transcripts by email, ensure you have opted for "Scan Copy". For any clarifications or queries, contact helpdesk.coe@vit.ac.in or call +91 416 220 2851 / 2852 between 9:00 am to 12:30 pm and 2:30 pm to 5:00 pm. There is no offline process for applying for transcripts.

rows.actual_answer: The Students' Records Section handles requests for duplicate student ID cards and bonafide certificates.

rows.query: Where can I find the VIT anti-ragging committee information?
rows.actual_answer: You can find information about the VIT Anti-Ragging Committee on their official page. The committee's chairperson's email is arc.sw@vit.ac.in. You can also reach the university hotline at 0416 - 220 5005, 0416 - 220 2240, or 0416 - 5055. Additionally, a list of committee members is available in the 'Anti Ragging Team 2025 2026' document.
